purpose: Bind the exact Playwright browser revisions used by the v1 qualification lanes. Playwright resolves browser binaries through the browsers.json driver manifest shipped INSIDE each pinned playwright/playwright-core package; pinning the package version therefore pins the browser revision. The runtime download URL is revision-numbered (e.g. .../chromium/1208/...), so a pinned revision's archive is content-stable. Do not claim an arbitrary installed Chromium qualifies v1: verify the installed package's browsers.json matches this pin set.

consumed_by: .github/workflows/qualification-v1.yml (browser matrix: chromium/firefox/webkit via npx playwright install --with-deps)
.github/workflows/pages.yml (browser_smoke.py against the published Pages demo, chromium only)

verification.method: Read the browsers.json driver manifest from the INSTALLED playwright-core (node_modules/playwright-core/browsers.json) and, when the python playwright package is installed, from its driver package; assert every revision recorded here matches. Exits non-zero on mismatch or missing install.
verification.note: Tip-of-tree browser entries (chromium-tip-of-tree, firefox-beta) exist in browsers.json but are not used by any v1 lane and are not part of this pin set.
